Messages.Author: Gwen Morse
Messages.Body:
I know that when WoTC changed from Jyhad to Vampire, they eliminated
some cards from the Jyhad run, and changed the names of others. I have a
list of all the cards that only appeared in 'Jyhad'. However, I have not
been able to find a list of cards that only appear in the main release
of V:TES (or card name changes).

If someone would provide me with this information, I would appreciate
it. :)

Gwen Morse

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Gwen Morse wrote:
>
> I know that when WoTC changed from Jyhad to Vampire, they eliminated
> some cards from the Jyhad run, and changed the names of others. I have a
> list of all the cards that only appeared in 'Jyhad'. However, I have not
> been able to find a list of cards that only appear in the main release
> of V:TES (or card name changes).

Removed:
Camille Devereux
Chainsaw
Concealed Weapon
Monocle of Clarity
Movement of the Slow Body
Rötschreck
Rowan Ring
Stake

They are replaced with:
Archon Investigation
Elder Intervention
Justicar Retribution
Protected Resources
Raven
Shadow of the Beast
Wooden Stake

Two cards got renamed in the process:
Kine Dominance -> Dominate Kine,
Gangrel De-evolution -> Gangrel Atavism

--
